h1: Fence Staining Cost in Sugar Land & Fort Bend County
bodyHtml:
Fence Staining Cost in Sugar Land & Fort Bend County

For a standard 6-foot fence, fence staining runs about $4–$7 per linear foot for typical lengths. Smaller fences land near a ~$565 starting point because every job includes setup, cleaning, and labor. Pricing is driven by the size of the fence (length × height), the wood’s condition, and the stain and sealer used.

Want a number right now? Use the instant estimate calculator below, then book a free on-site visit for an exact, written quote.

Schedule My Free Estimate

Quick Fence Staining Price Breakdown

Typical totals for a standard 6-foot-tall fence (stain & sealer materials plus labor):

Small Fence

≈ 50–100 linear ft
Average Fence

Large Fence
$880 – $1,100+

Per linear foot, longer fences cost less (the fixed setup is spread over more footage); short fences cost more per foot for the same reason.

These are ballpark figures based on our standard model. Both-sides staining, heavy cleaning or stripping, and damaged wood can change the number — your written estimate reflects your actual fence.

What Drives Fence Staining Cost

  • Size (length × height): total square footage of wood is the biggest factor in how much stain and labor a job takes.

  • Wood condition: weathered, graying, or previously coated wood needs more prep.

  • Cleaning & prep: washing and brightening before stain helps it absorb and last.

  • Stain & sealer: transparent, semi-transparent, and solid stains differ in look and lifespan.

  • One side vs. both sides: staining both faces increases material and labor.

  • Gates and height: taller panels and gates add detail work.

What's Included

  • Surface cleaning and prep appropriate to the wood's condition

  • Protection of nearby plants, hardscape, and structures

  • Professional-grade stain and sealer application

  • Cleanup and final walkthrough

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does fence staining cost?

For a standard 6-foot fence, expect about $4–$7 per linear foot, with most jobs totaling between $670 and $1,100+. Smaller fences start around $565 because of setup and labor.

How is the price calculated?

We estimate the stain needed from your fence’s length and height, add materials and labor, and give you one clear total. Use the calculator above for an instant ballpark.

How often should I re-stain my fence?

In the Gulf Coast climate, most fences benefit from re-staining every few years; semi-transparent and solid stains last longer than transparent finishes.

Do you stain both sides of the fence?

We can stain one or both visible faces. Staining both sides increases material and labor, which is reflected in the estimate.

Do you clean the fence before staining?

Yes. Cleaning and, where needed, brightening the wood helps the stain absorb evenly and last longer.
